records.basis: Both keep the stated date, start/end and arrival times, location, free/no-selling rule, 1-3 eligible books, voluntary exchange/no guarantee, 20-person cap, deadline, group reply and same-group questions. No necessary edit established. Original/31 previously also both usable.

The day2 ingredient list and final accounting use two eggs, but the recipe only optionally adds one egg when the rice is dry; no step uses the planned two. This makes the claim of all six eggs consumed inconsistent with actual instructions.
records.minimumEdit: Either explicitly cook the planned two eggs in day2 fried rice, or revise the optional egg use and final remaining count. Finishing all six eggs is not itself required.
uncertaintiesNotPromotedToHardFailure: The 200g dry-rice batch is shared across two dinners without a clear reserved amount. Clarifying the split would help, but the source gives no mandatory grams per person, and the second meal also contains substantial tofu and other ingredients; do not invent a nutrition minimum or assert definite starvation.
Day2 cabbage can be split between soup and stir-fry within the stated 250g; do not treat the word remaining as definitely using all 500g despite the day3 allocation.
Small optional carrot use does not require a compulsory exact nutrition/gram table.

records.basis: Quantities stay within the complete food inventory, known priority dates are met, ordinary dishes and parallel equipment use are described. No necessary edit established from supplied facts.
records.limit: Cooking was not performed. A particular rice cooker's cycle time is unknown; do not assert either universal 40-minute success or definite failure from an invented minimum cycle.

The word willing can be read as voluntary, but no explicit name-only/fictional alternative is supplied for these activities. Do not report this as a clearly privacy-safe closure.
records.severityBoundary: Whether willing sharing satisfies the original non-compulsion boundary is a semantic disagreement, not a server-proved violation. Preserve the competing interpretation; no new blanket ban on voluntary conversation follows.

conclusion: GC38 has a notice tie and a meal pair with one local correction, matching the prior31 usability pattern rather than demonstrating stable gain. H01 does not establish a reliably closed privacy/time risk. These known cases cannot replace the failed CS adoption benefit criterion.
